resources.title: The Ann Arbor Renter's Commission
resources.description: The Ann Arbor Renter's Commission was established in 2021 to advise the Ann Arbor City Council on renters' issues. Several members of the AATU Reboot Task Force hold seats on the Renters Commission.

resources.title: Homelessness Resource Map
resources.description: Resources for folks who are unhoused and need day-to-day assistance; curated by Yvonne Winer.

resources.title: Legal Services of South Central Michigan (LSSCM)
resources.description: LSSCM provides free legal advice and representation to low-income folks in South Central Michigan.

resources.title: Fair Housing Center
resources.description: Free and low-cost services for discrimination cases in Michigan.

resources.title: Student Legal Services
resources.description: If you're a student, the best (and free) legal services for you could come from UMich SLS.

resources.title: Veterans Affairs Office
resources.description: The VA office also helps with emergency assistance for veterans.

resources.title: State Emergency Relief
resources.description: For low-income tenants to apply for financial assistance.

resources.title: The Washtenaw Housing Alliance
resources.description: The Washtenaw Housing Alliance is a coalition of over 30 nonprofit and government entities dedicated to ending homelessness in the Washtenaw County area.

resources.title: The Huron Valley Worker Organizing and Research Center (HV-WORC)
resources.description: HV-WORC was established in 2021 by delegates of the Huron Valley Area Labor Federation and allied community partners, to provide research and education in support of worker efforts for collective action.

resources.title: GEO Housing Caucus
resources.description: The Graduate Employees' Organization at the University of Michigan has partnered with the AATU in previous years through their Housing Caucus to advocate for Just Cause eviction laws in Ann Arbor.

resources.title: Michigan Rent Is Too Damn High
resources.description: The Rent Is Too Damn High coalition in Michigan is composed of 17 community organizations in Michigan fighting for rent control, social housing, and renters' rights at the state level.
